name: kingdoms-divide-choose-card-name-taxes-it-two-more
notes: Kingdom's Divide (qy34r8gffr): playing it now asks for a card name from the visible zones; choosing Dungeon Guide puts the tax tag on the champion (cards with that name cost 2 more to activate until the caster's next turn). Pre-fix it never asked.

rulesClauses: Choose a card name. Until the beginning of your next turn, cards with the chosen name cost 2 more to activate.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated opening body for Kingdom's Divide was registered ONLY in $activateCardAbilities, a table nothing dispatches (an action's effect lives in $cardActivatedAbilities): playing the card paid its cost and resolved with no effect (it never asked for a card name, so nothing was taxed even though the follow-up handler, the surcharge and the expiry all exist). Live registrations of the same bodies in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php.
